_evidence: Car-record overlay for esi of 0x0043c7d2 (compose after car_0043c677, which gives +0x1c a segment record 0..25 and random background). Gate 'movzx eax,byte [esi+0x202]; add eax,[0x63b830]; test eax,0x1f; jne exit' passes only when the sum is a multiple of 32 (a 1/32 chance with random bytes): +0x202 (the car's slot/phase byte) draws multiples of 0x20 most of the time plus 0x1f/5/0x21; byte +0x7f is the car's current choice 0..5 (it indexes the 6-dword table 0x63b844 with ecx at 0x43c8f3 and is stored to [0x6227ec], which state_0043c31b bounds to 0..5: 0x43ca8b clamps its own choice to <= 5); byte +0x7c is the driver number (0x43b974 forms the team-mate key ((n-1)&0x3f ^ 1)+1, 0x43c888 clamps (n&0x3f)-1 to <= 21 for the 0x66fd20 byte table): drawn 0..22 plus 0x41/0x7f. Flag bytes +0xfe (bit 2: 'test 4; jne exit') and +0x231 (bit 5: 'test 0x20; jne exit') draw from value lists that leave the tested bit clear in two thirds of the picks (other bits set too); any byte is a valid flag set.
